result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Neither answer says plainly that the hierarchy already works. Both raise many issues and treat the Save button's teal as a conflict, although it is a real wording inconsistency in the spec. Answer A recommends bigger section headings, which fails item 4, and adds a spacing problem between Reset and Save that the description doesn't support. Answer B's points are mostly about missing details the developer will need. It also says the type scale already has clear steps and doesn't push for any added decoration, so it is the better answer. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers hunt for problems instead of plainly saying the hierarchy works, and both make far more than one or two suggestions. A's points are mostly about handoff details (spacing values, Save/Reset behaviour, accessibility) and it never pushes visual additions. B recommends bigger section headings, calls Reset too close to Save without any basis in the description, and gives a muddled teal recommendation, though its list of what works is stronger.
